job.title: Production Operations Engineer
job.description:
A leading global proprietary trading firm is growing its production operations engineering team in Sydney. The firm trades its own capital and provides liquidity across listed derivatives, equities, ETFs, bonds and FX, with the Sydney office acting as a key hub for its Asia-Pacific trading.

You'll join a global team whose job is simple to describe and hard to do well: keep low-latency trading systems safe, stable and fast. It's a hands-on role with genuine ownership of production, close to the trading floor and the engineers who build the platform.

The role
  • Deploy, maintain and monitor proprietary trading applications, keeping them within tight performance thresholds
  • Support live trading, troubleshooting complex issues and resolving incidents quickly
  • Spot recurring themes in incidents and build the automation that stops them coming back
  • Coordinate go-lives for new products, systems and exchanges, including readiness for corporate actions and special announcements
  • Set configuration and deployment standards, and manage colocation capacity and redundancy as the firm grows
What you'll bring
  • L2/L3 experience managing complex distributed systems on Linux, with strong networking fundamentals
  • Python (or similar) scripting, plus hands-on CI/CD, build, deployment and version control tooling
  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL
  • A track record of driving system improvements and delivering change across global teams
  • Calm, logical troubleshooting under pressure, and the ability to explain technical issues clearly
Note - High-frequency trading experience is a plus, but genuinely not required.

Culture:
  • Highly collaborative, working daily with traders, developers and operations teams across regions
  • Fast-paced and high-intensity, with frequent change and plenty to learn
  • A team of curious, creative problem solvers who care about continuous improvement
  • Primarily business hours, with a rotational weekend roster supporting weekend trading and testing
What's on offer:
  • Permanent role with a performance-based bonus
  • Training, mentorship and personal development
  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship where necessary
If you enjoy owning production end to end and scripting problems out of existence, "APPLY" now or reach out to Guy Nardo at guy.nardo@pra.com.au or 0452 664 264 for a confidential chat.

job.title: Senior Product Manager (Authentication) — CIAM Transformation
job.description:
Senior Product Manager (Authentication) — CIAM Transformation
 
Join a well-established technology services and consulting organisation to take domain ownership and strategic product leadership across a major Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) transformation program.
 
The Role
 
You'll own the end-to-end authentication roadmap and backlog across digital and assisted channels, ensuring customer journeys strike the right balance between robust security, fraud prevention, regulatory compliance, and low-friction user experience.
 
As the primary business product owner for the modern CIAM platform, you'll drive product decisions and governance across login, step-up authentication, account recovery, adaptive/risk-based authentication, passwordless, and biometrics, working closely with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams spanning Digital, Engineering, Cyber Security, Fraud, Risk, and Customer Care to standardise reusable authentication capabilities across the enterprise.
 
If you thrive on navigating complex dependencies, defining high-impact KPIs, and leading enterprise-scale platform migrations, this is a chance to shape the organisation's overarching identity vision.
 
What You'll Bring
  • Extensive Product Management or Product Owner experience leading initiatives within CIAM, Digital Identity, Authentication, or Cyber Security domains
  • Deep expertise in modern authentication concepts and standards — OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SSO, MFA, passwordless, biometrics, risk-based adaptive authentication
  • Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale customer authentication platforms (Ping Identity, Okta/Auth0, ForgeRock, or equivalent)
  • Solid understanding of digital customer journeys, identity lifecycle management, security controls, and fraud risk mitigation
  • Experience in large-scale, highly regulated consumer environments (telecommunications or banking) highly desirable
  • Exceptional senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a proven ability to align competing business, security, customer experience, and delivery priorities
Why Apply
 
Work alongside experienced professionals on meaningful, high-impact identity work, with genuine support to grow your career in whichever direction interests you.
 
We celebrate diversity and inclusion, and are committed to equal employment opportunities and reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

This role sits within the Technology department, reporting through to the CTO. The role is responsible for the successful delivery of technology projects in accordance with approved business cases and the realisation of all identified benefits, while adhering to project management disciplines and governance processes.
It is essential that candidates are well versed in both waterfall and agile methodologies, with adequate experience successfully delivering technology project scope and benefits on time and on budget, ensuring key stakeholder expectations are well managed at all times, leading a project team, managing shared resources to deliver project outcomes, and ensuring external vendors and delivery partners deliver to agreed scope and standards.

Responsibilities:
  • Ensure the successful delivery of projects
  • Engage business stakeholders, validating requirements and success metrics for the project
  • Manage the project schedule, monitoring and addressing variations to timelines and scope
  • Accountable for cost control and adherence to project budgets
  • Identify, log and drive resolution of issues, risks, dependencies and assumptions
  • Day-to-day task management and outcomes of nominated project resources
  • Manage project compliance with governance requirements and program alignment to technology strategy
  • Manage technology changes through the relevant technology change review/approval forums
To be successful in this role, you will need:
  • Strong problem solving and decision making
  • Prioritisation of business requirements
  • Stakeholder alignment and solution endorsement
  • Technical and people conflict resolution
